target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of inference routing using a workload-to-model routing policy. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Derive inference routing — human review
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of inference routing using a workload-to-model routing policy. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.measure: quality, latency and cost per request class

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in a workload-to-model routing policy.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report quality, latency and cost per request class with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: selecting on hidden test answers.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of inference routing.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report quality, latency and cost per request class against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for selecting on hidden test answers; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
